_doc: ErAV campaign. Reuses the shared 4LDK floor 'house_floor_4ldk' (defined in BGAssets/House_4ldk/house_layout_4ldk.json) — no copy. Protagonist baseID is forced to 'ErAV_Player' (referenced by NPC initialRelationship). Last name is forced via campaign_init_playerNameIDs's optional [firstName, middleName, lastName, displayFormat] arguments (empty string = keep the player-chosen value; only lastName is overridden here). NOTE: the engine also currently keys the player relationship by the literal 'PLAYER' token (RelationshipManager.cs:776), so ErAV_Player-based relationships resolve once that lookup also matches the player's baseID.

extraOptions._doc_option: No forbidPCSelect: the protagonist is created in the custom character editor, then its baseID/family name are forced by the initializers below.

zh-cn.campaign_erav_tooltip: 双亲因事故离世，留下巨额连带保证债务。在黑道千金桐生歌音的最后通牒下，你必须在毕业前还清——接手AV事务所，还是自己另寻出路？
zh-cn.campaign_erav_custom_tooltip: 以可自定义的主角（强制姓氏「宫间」）开始游戏
zh-cn.campaign_erav_custom_noreplace_tooltip: 以可自定义的主角开始游戏
zh-cn.ErAV_Kanade_charaComment: 主角的亲妹妹。学业常年保持年级第一的优等生，运动却不太擅长。得知哥哥背负巨债后，主动决定成为ＡＶ女优帮忙还债。温柔清秀、献身的三项齐备，却隐藏着被封印的强势本性。
zh-cn.ErAV_Kanon_charaComment: 黑社会桐生组的掌上明珠，直爽的学生会长，辩论与谈判能力极高。是将主角卷入债务事件的罪魁祸首，也是事务所一切委托的发放者。公私有别：职场完全服从的女优，私下是不肯认输的大小姐。

en-us.campaign_erav_tooltip: Your parents died in an accident, leaving a crushing joint-guarantor debt. Under yakuza princess Kiryu Kanon's ultimatum, you must repay it before graduation — take over the AV agency, or find your own way out.
en-us.ErAV_Kanade_charaComment: The protagonist's younger sister. A top-of-her-class honor student, though poor at sports. On learning of her brother's crushing debt, she resolves to become an AV actress to help repay it. Gentle, demure and devoted, yet hides a sealed-away dominant nature.
en-us.ErAV_Kanon_charaComment: The pampered daughter of the Kiryu-gumi syndicate; a blunt student council president with formidable negotiation skills. She is the architect of the protagonist's debt entanglement and the issuer of every agency commission. Strictly separates public and private: an utterly compliant actress on set, a proud, unyielding ojou-sama off it.
